data.body: Fixed in 02cb77f706. Defensive post-return existence check added at top of Step 1 in per-worktree-review-commit.md and single-agent-integrate.md (HALT on missing worktree, ticket comment, exit 1). Striken the inaccurate sentinel-file claim in Worktree Retention Protocol — replaced with empirically-grounded summary of v2.1.150 retention discriminators. Empirical reproduction was inconclusive (6 probes survived) but the binary string evidence (tengu_worktree_removed + worktree_kept_* codes) is sufficient for landing the defensive check, which makes the silent failure mode loud regardless of the exact discriminator that fires.
